name: devicekit-vpn
description: Drive ExpressVPN across your fleet: provision a user-supplied, hash-pinned APK onto each device, then connect/disconnect/status through version-keyed UI adapters that absorb the app's drift (a 13.x per-connect consent dialog is just an extra adapter step). Validates every requested exit country against an allowlist — even the AI can't route to a non-approved country — and verifies the real egress with a device-side geo-IP check, because the app UI alone can't reveal a wrong-country connection. The worked example for plan 18's app-driver model; app-agnostic underneath.
author: Juan Denis

allowed_countries.label: Allowed exit countries (ISO codes, comma-separated — empty = any)

max_app_version.label: Global version ceiling (e.g. 12 pins the whole 12.x line)

geo_endpoint.label: Geo-IP endpoint for the egress check

allow_reprovision.label: Allow reprovision (destructive: uninstall + reinstall the pinned build)
